description: Localisation des zones inondables sur la commune de Bergerac - étude hydraulique juin 1999 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Bergerac. Location of flood zones in the municipality of Bergerac based on a hydraulic study conducted by the City of Bergerac in June 1999. Coverage: Commune de Bergerac. The portal shows the English title as "Location of flood zones in the municipality of Bergerac — hydraulic study June 1999" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Bergerac. Its keywords include bergerac, zone-inondable, inondable. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2019-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
